email.title: Stay Connected with Your Community

payments.sub: What happens between a donor's click and the money reaching your organisation.

steps.title: The donor chooses {{name}}
steps.body: On your Donorfit donation form, the donor picks a payment method offered through {{name}}.

steps.title: {{name}} processes the payment
steps.body: {{name}} handles the payment and confirms whether it went through.

steps.title: The donation is recorded
steps.body: The confirmed contribution appears in Donorfit, ready for your donor records and reports.

steps.title: Funds reach your bank
steps.body: {{name}} pays the money out to your organisation's bank account, based on your {{name}} account settings.

steps.title: Supporters are managed in Donorfit

steps.title: Connect your {{name}} account
steps.body: Link {{name}} to Donorfit, with help from our team if you need it.

stripe.tagline: Accept card and wallet payments on your Donorfit donation forms, processed by Stripe.
about: Stripe is a global payment platform that businesses and non-profits use to accept payments online. It handles card payments, digital wallets and several European bank payment methods.
Connected to Donorfit, Stripe processes the payments donors make through your forms, while Donorfit keeps track of who gave, how much and to which cause.

benefits.title: A familiar checkout
benefits.body: Donors pay with the card or wallet they already use on their phone or laptop.

benefits.title: Quick giving on mobile
benefits.body: Apple Pay and Google Pay let donors confirm a gift on their phone without typing in card details.

benefits.title: Clear payment records
benefits.body: Stripe's dashboard lists every payment and payout, which helps when you compare figures with Donorfit.

needs: A Stripe account in your organisation's name
Your organisation and bank details verified with Stripe
Administrator access to the Stripe dashboard
A list of the payment methods you want to offer donors

paypal.tagline: Let donors give with their PayPal account on your Donorfit donation forms.
about: PayPal is one of the most widely used online payment services. Donors log in to their PayPal account and confirm the payment without entering card details.
With PayPal connected, donors can choose it on your Donorfit forms. The payment is completed in PayPal, and the donation is recorded in Donorfit.

benefits.title: A name donors know
benefits.body: Many donors already have a PayPal account and know how it works.

benefits.title: No card details to type
benefits.body: Donors confirm with their PayPal login, which keeps the checkout short.

benefits.title: Payments visible in PayPal
benefits.body: Incoming donations also show up in your PayPal business account.

needs: A PayPal Business account for your organisation
Your account verified with PayPal
Administrator access to the PayPal account

gocardless.tagline: Collect one-off and regular gifts by bank debit through GoCardless.
about: GoCardless specialises in bank payments. Donors authorise a Direct Debit mandate once, and payments are then collected from their bank account.
This suits regular giving such as monthly donations, membership fees and sponsorships. With GoCardless connected, donors can pay by bank debit through Donorfit.

benefits.title: Made for regular giving
benefits.body: One mandate covers future payments, so supporters don't have to give again by hand each month.

benefits.title: No expiring cards
benefits.body: Bank debit doesn't depend on a card's expiry date, so regular gifts carry on when a card is replaced.

benefits.title: Straight from the bank
benefits.body: Donors pay from their bank account, without a card or a separate payment app.

needs: A GoCardless account for your organisation
Your organisation and bank account verified with GoCardless
Administrator access to the GoCardless dashboard

micropayment.tagline: Offer donors in Germany familiar payment methods through Micropayment.
about: Micropayment is a payment service provider based in Germany. It offers payment methods many donors in Germany already know, such as direct debit and card payments.
Connected to Donorfit, Micropayment processes the payments donors make through your forms, and Donorfit records each contribution.

benefits.title: A German payment partner
benefits.body: A good fit for organisations whose supporters are mainly in Germany.

benefits.title: Familiar methods
benefits.body: Direct debit and bank transfer are common ways to give in Germany.

benefits.title: Several methods, one account
benefits.body: The payment methods you offer are managed together in a single Micropayment account.

needs: A Micropayment account for your organisation
Your organisation's details verified with Micropayment
Administrator access to your Micropayment account

mollie.tagline: Offer cards and popular European payment methods through Mollie.
about: Mollie is a payment provider headquartered in Amsterdam. It supports cards and many local European payment methods, such as iDEAL in the Netherlands and Bancontact in Belgium.
With Mollie connected, donors can pay through your Donorfit forms with the method most common in their country, and each donation is recorded in Donorfit.

benefits.title: Local methods across Europe
benefits.body: Donors in different countries can pay the way they're used to.

benefits.title: Many methods, one account
benefits.body: Cards and local methods are managed together in one Mollie account.

benefits.title: A clear overview
benefits.body: Mollie's dashboard lists every payment and settlement for your own checks.

needs: A Mollie account for your organisation
Your organisation's details verified with Mollie
The payment methods you want to offer switched on in your Mollie dashboard

brevo.tagline: Reach donors and members with newsletters and email campaigns sent through Brevo.
about: Brevo, formerly Sendinblue, is a marketing platform from France for email campaigns, newsletters and contact management. It also offers SMS and automation features.
Used alongside Donorfit, Brevo helps you keep in touch with the donors and members you manage in Donorfit through regular newsletters.

benefits.title: Regular updates
benefits.body: Share project news and thank-you messages with the people who support you.

benefits.title: Design without code
benefits.body: Brevo's drag-and-drop editor helps you build newsletters without technical skills.

benefits.title: See what works
benefits.body: Brevo reports opens and clicks, so you can improve your next campaign.

needs: A Brevo account for your organisation
A verified sender email address in Brevo
Administrator access to your Brevo account

mailchimp.tagline: Send newsletters and updates to your supporters with Mailchimp.
about: Mailchimp is an email marketing platform, part of Intuit, for creating newsletters, managing audiences and sending campaigns.
Used alongside Donorfit, Mailchimp helps you keep in touch with the donors and members you manage in Donorfit through regular newsletters.

benefits.title: An easy editor
benefits.body: Create clean newsletters with Mailchimp's templates and drag-and-drop editor.

benefits.title: Organised audiences
benefits.body: Group contacts with tags and segments to send the right message to the right people.

benefits.title: Campaign reports
benefits.body: Track opens and clicks for every campaign you send.

needs: A Mailchimp account for your organisation
A verified sender email address in Mailchimp
Administrator access to your Mailchimp account
